content.short: Lumiterra provides cutting-edge infrastructure for web3 games, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Lumiterra is a multiplayer, open-world survival crafting game where you can battle, farm with your friends or mysterious collected creatures in a vast world. As a prominent player in the Decentralized Games space, Lumiterra specializes in delivering high-quality web3 games infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Lumiterra focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: Lumiterra provides innovative web3 games tools for the Decentralized Games space. Discover Lumiterra and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
